opening.quote: Good mourning, Tidewell um Home, my name is Femke. can I help today?
opening.comment: The agent gave her name and the company name in the first turn, so the greeting meets the standard.

verification.quote: could I take your full name and the number or postcode?
verification.comment: The agent asked for the full name and postcode before discussing the order, which is correct.

understanding.quote: Thank you, uh Mark. I can see the payment of €120.00 for a dining chair set. you've that payment with your bank and want to know the next step?
understanding.comment: The agent captured the dispute and the payment details without asking the caller to repeat them.

resolution_accuracy.quote: Your bank will contact you with their decision.
resolution_accuracy.comment: The agent made no incorrect timeline or eligibility claims, though she did not explain the Payments team process, which is a gap rather than an error.

process_compliance.quote: I'll make a note on your order that you've opened uh dispute.
process_compliance.comment: The policy requires bank disputes to be passed to the Payments team, who reply within 2 working days, but the agent only noted the order and did not hand the case over.

communication.quote: I'm sorry you had to and go to you bank over this.
communication.comment: The agent was polite and apologetic throughout, and the caller was not visibly upset.

closing.quote: Is there anything elf I can help with?
closing.comment: The agent confirmed the next step of an email and asked if there was anything else, then closed politely with thanks.
